rationale_bullets: Zero FBS production returns or arrives: 2025 was 86th-pctile as-played but entirely Brendon Lewis (PFF 87.2 on 447 dropbacks, graduated); the 2026 room is Stokes (Division II) + Noland (13 career FBS attempts).

Stokes's D2 resume is real and deep: 18 starts, 4,890 yds (66%, 44-21 TD-INT), 987 rush yds at West Florida; 2025 Harlon Hill finalist; PS QB#31 positional rank; Athlon 2026: 'expected to land the starting job.' Dual-threat profile fits Decker's speed-spread (attributed).

Noland provides pedigree insurance: former consensus top-100/4-star (Ohio State signee), 2 gm/13 att (67%) at South Carolina 2025, PS#45; CFN 2026-07-07 calls him a 'big-time QB prospect.' Huff 2026-04-04: 'heavyweight slugging it' - both playing well enough to keep it open.
Nothing resolves before fall: no starter named in spring AND the public spring game was weather-postponed (rollingout 2026-04-18) - zero live-competition data exists for either QB vs FBS defense.

Placement: better-credentialed room than a bare open battle (extensive D2 dominance + blue-chip pedigree) but a two-level translation for the favorite - below FBS average at 40, above Iowa-QB-32-style rooms on production, below the Nebraska-WRTE-50 average band.
